title: SDG: State-Dependent Gating at Chunk Boundaries for Linear Attention
abstract: arXiv:2611.26637v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent gated linear attention models use state-independent gates, computed from token representations without directly reading the recurrent memory. This design supports efficient chunkwise computation: sequences are divided into chunks of consecutive tokens, with parallel computation within each chunk. However, the same token representation produces the same gate, even when the layer stores different information. We introduce State-Dependent Gating (SDG), which computes element-wise gates from the change in memory over a chunk and applies them at the chunk boundary. This provides state feedback for forgetting while preserving parallel computation within each chunk. We develop fused kernels for Gated DeltaNet, Kimi Delta Attention, Gated DeltaNet-2, and Mamba-3. translated_title: SDG：面向线性注意力的分块边界状态依赖门控
translated_abstract: 近期的门控线性注意力模型使用状态无关的门控机制，该门控由token表示计算得出，而不直接读取循环记忆。这种设计支持高效的分块计算：序列被划分为连续token组成的块，并在每个块内进行并行计算。然而，即使层中存储的信息不同，相同的token表示仍会产生相同的门控。我们提出了状态依赖门控（SDG），它根据记忆在一个块上的变化计算逐元素门控，并将其应用于块的边界。这在保持每个块内并行计算的同时，为遗忘机制提供了状态反馈。我们为Gated DeltaNet、Kimi Delta Attention、Gated DeltaNet-2和Mamba-3开发了融合内核。我们的理论分析在信号-噪声模型下量化了状态依赖的逐元素门控在重建方面的潜在收益。我们还表明，边界衰减（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出SDG方法，通过在分块边界处依据记忆状态的变化计算逐元素门控，为线性注意力模型提供状态反馈的遗忘机制，同时保持块内并行计算的高效性。
en_tdlr: Proposes State-Dependent Gating (SDG), which computes element-wise gates from memory changes at chunk boundaries, providing state feedback for forgetting in linear attention models while preserving efficient intra-chunk parallel computation.
